analysis.summary: Sonam Limited released its H1 FY27 financial results reporting a significant increase in revenue from operations, EBITDA, and Profit After Tax compared to the corresponding period of the previous financial year. Management highlighted the company's manufacturing capabilities in Morbi, Gujarat, featuring an installed production capacity of 72 lakhs p.a. for clocks and 240 lakhs p.a. for clock movements. The company emphasized its strategic focus on strengthening product portfolios, enhancing operational capabilities, maintaining financial discipline, and expanding distribution networks.

guidance.claim: The company expects full-year growth guidance of 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates revenue for the next quarter to be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong operational performance and deadly demand across the product portfolio during the first quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: The positive market response to new products has been encouraging and reinforces confidence in the long-term growth strategy.
demand_outlook.quote: The positive market response to this new product has been encouraging and strengthens our confidence in our long-term growth strategy.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has a lot of export orders and corporate orders along with a good order book.
demand_outlook.quote: Now, we have a lot of orders for export, but some orders are pending because, goods are ready, but shipment is not happening. Due to this war scenario, the freight cost has increased. We also have a lot of corporate orders. We have a good order book.

demand_outlook.claim: Export demand has been impacted by the situation in Iraq.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes. Export demand has been affected. Our main export market is Iraq. We have a lot of orders from Iraq. Goods are also ready. But we are on hold due to logistic problems. It is temporary.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin stood at 6.07% in H1 FY27 compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.07%, compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that margins are currently fluctuating due to daily increases and decreases in raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

margins_costs.claim: Margins were affected due to market competition, increases in raw material prices, and geographical war situations.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, sir, because market’s competition and revenue has increased, but margin has not increased because of so many problems in raw material price increase and this situation of war in geographies.

orders_capacity.claim: Current manufacturing capacity utilization is running at 60% to 70% on a quarter-to-quarter basis.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividend paid (including corporate dividend tax) amounted to 120.10 lakhs for the period ended 30-09-2026.
Management stated there are no requirements for additional borrowing currently to fund future growth.
Debtors reduced from Rs. 10 crore in 2024-25 to Rs. 6.73 crores in 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: 2024-25 debtors is Rs. 10 crore and 2025-26, debtors is only Rs. 6.73 crores. Debtors have reduced.

capital_allocation.claim: The company operates on 70% to 80% advance payments with credit extended only to old customers.
capital_allocation.quote: No. our cash flow is more and our presence in market, our value is like, we are working in 70% to 80% in advance. It is going on credit to old customers. So, we will not have that much effect.

risks_headwinds.claim: Certain statements in the document may be forward-looking in nature and involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and other factors which may cause actual results, performance, or achievements of the Company to differ materially.
risks_headwinds.quote: Certain statements in this document may be forward-looking in nature and involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and other factors which may cause actual results, performance, or achievements of the Company to differ materially from those expressed or implied.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports are experiencing a slight negative impact due to price increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

risks_headwinds.claim: Logistic problems and increased freight costs have delayed shipments despite ready goods due to the war scenario.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now, we have a lot of orders for export, but some orders are pending because, goods are ready, but shipment is not happening. Due to this war scenario, the freight cost has increased.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to maintaining high product quality standards from both customer and regulatory perspectives through continuous process reviews, timely corrective actions, and technology-driven quality management systems.
management_commitments.quote: The Company remains committed to maintaining high product quality standards from both customer and regulatory perspectives through continuous process reviews, timely corrective actions, and technology-driven quality management systems.

management_commitments.claim: Sonam Limited will continue expanding its product portfolio by introducing a broader range of innovative and premium clock designs.
management_commitments.quote: Sonam Limited will continue expanding its product portfolio by introducing a broader range of innovative and premium clock designs while strengthening its leadership position in the industry.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to develop items in the Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 price range during the 2027-28 period.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to conduct a trial phase on online marketplaces for two to three months before scaling up.
management_commitments.quote: Wall clock is such an item where there is a part for damage. So, that is why we have started a trial phase. We will check for two, three months that how much goods are returned to us and how much damage we are facing. After that, we will start in full force.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
